newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National up after profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National up after profits rise.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc were up 15p to 778-1/2 by 0836 GMT after the banking group reported a 20 percent jump in full-year pre-tax profits to 1.228 billion stg, in line with analysts' expectations.
"The results were as expected but the trading statement was certainly a lot more confident than NatWest's," the head of trading at a large brokerage said.
"Abbey also seems pretty confident it will win the ScotAM bid."
On Tuesday, National Westminster Bank Plc posted slightly disappointing full-year results and issued a cautious trading statement, predicting that the pace of UK economic growth would slow in 1998.
Abbey National, in contrast, said it intended to broaden its earnings base to reduce dependence on traditional mortgage and saving activities.
As part of that strategy, the group confirmed it would be making a formal bid for life assurer Scottish Amicable on Friday and expressed confidence its bid would be "attractive" to the ScotAM board.
